summary: Removed the positional-argument form of 'auth set-token' entirely; the token is now only accepted via stdin.
reason: Greptile's first-round publish review (mvanhorn/printing-press-library PR #1794) found that the generated 'auth set-token <token>' command required the credential as args[0], exposing it via the process argument list (ps) and shell history. An initial fix kept the positional form for backward compatibility alongside a new --stdin flag; the second review round judged that insufficient because the insecure path remained supported and was still advertised in auth.go's own hints, client.go's error-remediation text, README.md, and SKILL.md. All of those now point at the stdin form exclusively, and 'set-token' takes no positional argument at all. Likely a systemic gap in the generated auth.go template across CLIs with api_key auth; flagging via retro as well.
validated_outcome: go build succeeded; manually verified 'echo token | jules-pp-cli auth set-token' saves the credential, and that a positional argument is now rejected as an unknown command rather than accepted.
